No native allocation stacks or module attribution was obtained. This does not mean zero allocations or unavailable command support.

Combined cold-open adjacent readsets show isolate JS used +17340404B, allocated JS heap +41271296B, embedder GC used +55788360B, backing +281151B, while sampled owned RSS +139853824B. The cold API combines fixture/admission/mount/font-ready/native completion and source inventory; no subphase/owner is identified.

After font query -> warm, JS used falls3856420B and embedder GC used falls50352320B, while allocated JS heap grows11534336B and sampled owned RSS grows45694976B. Counter movement is not monotonic. No GC event trace exists; do not assert when or why collection occurred.

Warm -> print adjacent readsets show JS used +1848576B, embedder GC used +15562184B, backing +6892B, sampled owned RSS -20496384B and native nodes +4501. The separate series do not yield causal RSS/native byte accounting.

clearPrint and dispose remove live native print/pages/surfaces, while final global native counter remains7857 and listener count114. No forced GC was requested. Global counters at this one cleanup seam do not prove a leak or object lifetime.

No new allocation owner, function cause or semantic source repair is justified. Supported-empty native profiles leave attribution unresolved. Preserve the observed combined cold/warm/print boundaries and existing renderer source-object proof as separate evidence; no new diagnostic/profile is authorized.
